_note: Machine-readable map of SOC 2100. verify_course.py --course 2100 checks the prose against this file. SOC 2100 is a 2000-level survey of social problems, taught through A Different World.

course.title: Social Problems

outcomes.LO1: Explain how a condition becomes defined as a social problem (claims-making and constructionism)
outcomes.LO2: Apply sociological evidence to a specific social problem
outcomes.LO3: Distinguish structural accounts of problems from individual and deficit accounts
outcomes.LO4: Separate documented facts from interpretations when reading a text about a problem
outcomes.LO5: Evaluate an empirical claim about a social problem using primary data
outcomes.LO6: Propose and defend a response to a social problem, with its costs and beneficiaries

core_readings: Joel Best, Social Problems (any recent edition)
